data.action: 大口吃着大碗烤肉饭，腮帮鼓鼓
data.description: 【森蚺 · 食堂干饭】中午罗德岛食堂内，森蚺面前摆着三个大号海碗，正大口大口狂炫着堆成小山般的萨贡烤肉拌饭，腮帮子鼓得像只可爱的小仓鼠。吃完一口她满足地拍了拍平坦的小腹——「吃饱了才有力气去机库打铁！博士，你碗里的肉如果吃不下的话，我也能全包哦！」
data.promptProse: Eunectes eats roasted-meat rice at the cafeteria table with chopsticks, cheeks puffed from a large bite and tail moving happily beside her seat. Green halter top, tactical vest and leather shorts retain her outfit. The medium close-up includes three filled bowls and emptied dishes, with other diners farther back. Bright midday ceiling light illuminates steam and browned meat, casting overlapping bowl shadows across the tabletop before her satisfied grin.
data.title: 森蚺 · 食堂干饭
